يعتطفان (form VIII)

# يُعْتَطَفَانِ (yuʕtaṭafāni) /juʕ.ta.tˤa.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
